scenario: [RLOW.6.1.9]: on integer storage a rounding works on the exact value in the unit, `(Q·x - R) / P`, for either sign of `P`, with the builtin's integer taken back as `n::<unit>` is ([LEXP.3.2]: `round` ties to even). `owed` is `x * -100` cents, so P = -100, Q = 1, R = 0. Slot `o` holds -250 cents, 2.5 owed: `round` 2 (ties to even), `math.trunc` 2, `math.floor` 2, `math.ceil` 3. Slot `p` holds 350 cents, -3.5 owed: `round` -4 (ties to even), `math.floor` -4, `math.ceil` -3, `math.trunc` -3. Each is its own rule, compared with the unit literal, and all eight log in source order. The positive-factor arithmetic (`x // f` and `x % f` with f = -100) takes `math.ceil(r.o)` to 2, and `math.ceil(r.p)` and `math.trunc(r.p)` to -4, so `o ceil`, `p ceil` and `p trunc` go silent. PATH PINNED: `dsc.rete.rlow_6_1_9_tier1`, whose numerator is negated for P < 0 so the division is by |P|, then `rlow_6_1_9_multiple` and `rlow_6_1_10_int` back, evaluated by each runtime.
rules_ds:
import math

unit dimension ledger storage int64 base cent
unit cent: ledger
unit owed: ledger = x * -100

schema L scope logical:
    id: String key
    o: owed mutable
    p: owed mutable

rule o_round:
    L r where round(r.o) == 2_owed
->
    log info "o round"

rule o_trunc:
    L r where math.trunc(r.o) == 2_owed
->
    log info "o trunc"

rule o_floor:
    L r where math.floor(r.o) == 2_owed
->
    log info "o floor"

rule o_ceil:
    L r where math.ceil(r.o) == 3_owed
->
    log info "o ceil"

rule p_round:
    L r where round(r.p) == -4_owed
->
    log info "p round"

rule p_floor:
    L r where math.floor(r.p) == -4_owed
->
    log info "p floor"

rule p_ceil:
    L r where math.ceil(r.p) == -3_owed
->
    log info "p ceil"

rule p_trunc:
    L r where math.trunc(r.p) == -3_owed
->
    log info "p trunc"
